name: puppy-console
description: a pane with your conversations first, then one card per production pipeline, read from small status files

status_dir.title: Status folder
status_dir.description: The folder your pipelines write their status files into (see FORMAT.md). ~ is your home folder.

notify.title: Notices
notify.description: on shows a short notice, while the console pane is open, when a card turns waiting, error or quiet, or gets a new waiting item; off shows none.

conversations.title: Conversations
conversations.description: on: each conversation writes a short file about itself into ~/.claude/console/sessions/ (this computer only) after every turn, and the pane shows them first. off: it writes nothing.

push.title: Push
push.description: on: when a conversation stops to ask you something, send a push through the app's PushNotification tool, if your permission settings already allow it (no dialog is opened). off: none.
